disease_state.evidence: inferred: A number of genetic factors predispose towards PD, among them mutations in GBA1, which encodes the lysosomal enzyme acid-β-glucosidase.

material_type.evidence: inferred: Human brain samples were obtained as frozen tissue from the Queens Square Brain Bank of London, and included 21 IPD patients without a GBA mutation, 21 PD-GBA patients and 21 controls, from five different brain regions (OCC, MTG, CG, STR and SN).
